title: 超濾膜前處理
summary: 本課以UF 進水預處理、通量、完整性與淨產水為主線，從進水組成與孔徑邊界、攔截與預處理試驗、膜面積與通量、跨膜壓與壓力量測進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops uf feed conditioning, flux, integrity and net production through ten connected units, beginning with feed constituents and separation boundary, screening and pretreatment trials, membrane area and flux, transmembrane pressure measurement. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。

steps.title: 進水組成與孔徑邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Feed constituents and separation boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進水組成與孔徑邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feed constituents and separation boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 區分懸浮顆粒、膠體、溶解鹽與有機物；UF 不會因為水變清就把所有溶解物去掉。
steps.instructionEn: Separate particles, colloids, dissolved salts and organics; clarified UF permeate does not imply removal of all dissolved species.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Cin=100 mg/L；Cout=20 mg/L。模型 η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：濃度去除率僅在進出流量相等時等於質量去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Cin=100 mg/L; Cout=20 mg/L. Model η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Concentration removal equals mass removal only for equal inlet/outlet flow.
steps.failure: 以低濁度宣稱已完成脫鹽。診斷與介入：配對進出水流量及分析基準，另外確認轉化產物。
steps.failureEn: Low turbidity is used to claim desalination. Diagnostic response: Match inlet/outlet flow and analysis bases and check transformation products separately.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「進水組成與孔徑邊界」的觀測點。用相同分析方法與流量加權樣本，另列流量差異。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed constituents and separation boundary. Use matching methods and flow-weighted samples and report any flow difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 攔截與預處理試驗：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Screening and pretreatment trials: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 攔截與預處理試驗 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Screening and pretreatment trials and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 預處理要保護纖維與流道；混凝等方案需測對通量、殘餘物與清洗相容性的影響。
steps.instructionEn: Pretreatment protects fibers/channels; coagulation options require tests of flux, residuals and cleaning compatibility.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：原水濁度=50 NTU；沉降後=5 NTU。模型 ηT=(T0-T)/T0，代入得到 0.9 fraction。適用邊界：濁度指標不是污染物質量或病原去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Raw turbidity=50 NTU; settled turbidity=5 NTU. Model ηT=(T0-T)/T0 gives 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Turbidity reduction is not contaminant mass or pathogen removal.
steps.failure: 只看出水濁度而漏掉膜阻力快速上升。診斷與介入：重做同批原水平行試驗，分開藥量、剪切與時間的影響。
steps.failureEn: Effluent turbidity is checked while rapidly rising membrane resistance is missed. Diagnostic response: Repeat parallel tests on one water batch, separating dose, shear and time effects.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「攔截與預處理試驗」的觀測點。所有杯使用相同攪拌、沉降時間並同時量 pH。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for screening and pretreatment trials. Use matching mixing/settling times across jars and measure pH. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
